programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple got married in Hawaii 18 years ago, and after winning $5 million on a scratcher, they're moving to the Big Island; with a huge budget, David searches for properties with ocean views, and takes in the Big Kona energy along the way.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: When a Pennsylvanian woman receives an inheritance, it gives her the opportunity to move to the warm shores of Myrtle Beach, S.C.; David helps her and her bestie navigate beach real estate to find her forever home.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple living in her grandmother's tiny two-bedroom house have never had the means to buy their own home -- until they win $1 million on a scratch-off; David searches Akron, Ohio, for a home with a big yard and enough space to host band practice.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: Thanks to an inheritance, a longtime Georgia resident has the chance to buy a large family home closer to her grown-up children in Lubbock, Texas; David shows her some beautiful, spacious places where the houses are big, but the prices are small.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple battling an illness was in a terrible place financially and physically, so when they scratched a million dollars, they knew it was the answer to their prayers; David steps in to help find the perfect place for them to recuperate.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: First cousins and BFFs grew up like sisters, so when one gets the chance to buy a family home, the other gets a room of her own and a bathtub; on David's first trip to Memphis, and he searches for the grand, sprawling house of their dreams.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A mom uses her son's birthdate as inspiration to buy a scratch ticket and wins $1 million; she's ready to get out of the city and into the suburbs, but with low inventory, David will need his own good luck charm to find her dream home.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple caring for elderly parents couldn't afford a home for themselves until he won $1 million on a scratcher; David searches for a well-appointed condo with a huge kitchen so she can cook her Italian bolognese.
